response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM transactionrecord r JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), s AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS total FROM c) SELECT c.tradekind AS trader_type, c.cnt AS record_count, CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / s.total AS share_of_total, c.cnt - s.avg_cnt AS diff_from_average FROM c CROSS JOIN s WHERE s.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL AND c.cnt > s.avg_cnt

assumptions.assumption: Size of a trader type is the number of transaction records joined to traders of that type (inner join, so unmatched records are dropped); records, not distinct traders, are counted.
NULL tradekind forms its own group (GROUP BY keeps NULL as one group).
The average is the plain mean of per-type counts, including the NULL-type group if present.
